liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Brown-Eyed Women** (2 reviews): Garcia plays with a nice seventies tone, and the song is top notch; Tempo is slower than normal, giving the song an unusually fluid, slippery quality [11][15]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleoo** (1 review): Listener cried while hearing the jam, noting Jerry's brilliant melancholic flash near the end [14]
- **Supplication** (1 review): Listener notes the rare performance features Jerry Garcia firing on all cylinders [7]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): The performance is considered top notch, alongside the excellent Mississippi Half-Step [11]
- **Man Smart, Woman Smarter** (1 review): This version is the reason the show remains on the reviewer's top 10 list [17]
- **Corrina** (1 review): Reviewer also loved the version of this song, referring to it as Velveeta [17]
- **I Fought the Law** (1 review): Reviewer considers this song a waste of the encore slot [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Supplication**: back after 126 archived shows (698 days) [19]

## The recordings

- **gd93-05-22.sbd.gardner.9401.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 140 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the sound a 5 and the show a 4.5, noting a nice vibe [18]
- **gd93-05-22.sbd.miller.11665.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 133 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the jamming as crisp and kind, typical of 1990s low-gen soundboards; This copy removes tuning and crowd noise, making songs begin and end abruptly [7][8]
- **gd1993-05-22.137350.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 17 songs; 144 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1993-05-22.170346.Nak300.D5.bzlrbi.flac2448**: source not stated; 17 songs; 143 min [3]

## Around the show

- Band had exhausted their energy in Vegas and the previous Shoreline show [7]
- First performance of Mississippi Half-Step since October 31, 1984 [3]
- Another version is more complete and true to form, lacking this artificial flow [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-05-22.sbd.gardner.9401.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>??>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Signal path: SBD to DAT to unknown to DAT to CDR, seeded by Tony G [1]
- **gd93-05-22.sbd.miller.11665.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [6]
- **gd1993-05-22.137350.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) [2]
- **gd1993-05-22.170346.Nak300.D5.bzlrbi.flac2448**: taped by Recorded and transfered by Bzl.; source: (taper's section) Nak300s? > SonyD5 [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - May 23, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/may-23-1993) [20]
- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1993-05-22 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-05-22-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - May 22, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/may-22-1993) [22]
